body: Rubrics support the structured evaluation of language models. We propose a rubric for assessing expressed clinical reasoning in model responses, drawing on three bodies of work: medical education assessment frameworks (ART, SCT, Key Feature Problems and OSCE); clinical LLM benchmarks (MedR-Bench, HealthBench, TIMER-Bench, DR.BENCH, PrIME-LLM and PatientSafeBench); and general LLM reasoning evaluation research, including the Factuality-Validity-Coherence-Utility taxonomy, FaithCoT-Bench and C2-Faith. We use groundedness as a clinically oriented adaptation of the taxonomy's factuality category. The rubric brings these concepts together in a multidimensional framework for scoring free-text responses to gold-standard clinical vignettes. It includes provisional behavioural anchors, applicability rules and a separate flag for case-specific safety-critical errors. General-domain frameworks inform its design but are not treated as validated clinical instruments. The rubric does not replace case-specific reference criteria or the task-specific metrics of existing benchmarks. It has not yet been tested for inter-rater reliability, construct validity or clinical utility. Its immediate purpose is to make evaluation decisions explicit and open to scrutiny before empirical testing.
summaryZh: 本文提出了一种用于评估大模型临床推理能力的结构化评分框架。该框架整合了医学教育评估体系（如OSCE）、现有临床基准测试及通用LLM推理评估方法，引入了“扎根性”（Groundedness）作为事实性的临床适配指标。该评分体系包含行为锚点和安全关键错误标记，旨在为临床场景下的模型响应提供透明、可审查的评估标准，为医疗AI的临床应用安全性评估提供了重要参考。

glossary.explanationZh: 临床推理，指医生在诊断和治疗过程中分析患者信息并做出决策的思维过程。
扎根性，指模型输出内容是否基于可靠的临床证据或事实。
行为锚点，评估量表中用于定义不同评分等级的具体行为描述。
安全关键错误，指可能对患者健康造成直接危害的严重推理失误。
